grendel: Grendel — Grendel (nominative; the name's meaning is unknown — perhaps related to grindan 'to grind')
gē: gē — you (nominative plural of þū; cf. archaic 'ye')

hāl: hāl — whole, safe, unhurt (adjective, nominative singular masculine; cf. 'hale', 'whole')
hām: hām — home (tō hām 'homeward'; the ancestor of 'home') · hām — from home (dative singular, after fram)
hāten: hātan — called, named (past participle; wæs hāten 'was called')
hēap: hēap — troop, band, heap (accusative singular masculine; cf. 'heap')
hēt: hātan — commanded, ordered, called (3rd singular preterite)
lāð: lāð — hateful, loathsome (adjective; lāð ond longsum 'loathsome and long-lasting')
lēode: lēode — people, men (nominative plural) · lēode — people, men (accusative plural)
manna: mann — of men (genitive plural; manna hwone 'any of men')

maþelode: maþelian — spoke formally, made a speech (3rd singular preterite; from maþel 'assembly, speech')

mīne: mīn — my (possessive adjective, accusative plural masculine)
mīnne: mīn — my (possessive adjective, accusative singular masculine)
mōdes: mōd — of the heart, spirit (genitive singular)
mōt: mōtan — may, is permitted to (3rd singular present)
mōton: mōtan — may, be allowed to (plural present indicative; the subjunctive plural would be mōten; cf. 'must')
nīð: nīð — malice, affliction, violent enmity (accusative singular)
nō: nō — not at all, by no means (emphatic negative)
ond: ond — and (the usual spelling of and in this MS)

samod: samod — together, at the same time (adverb; cf. 'same')

sele: sele — hall (nominative singular) · sele — hall (dative singular)
slōg: slēan — slew, struck (3rd singular preterite; cf. 'slay')
snotere: snotor — wise, prudent (adjective, nominative plural masculine)
sē: sē — he, that one; the (nominative singular masculine of the demonstrative; sē þe 'he who')

wedera: Wederas — Weders, another name for the Geats (genitive plural)

wudu: wudu — wood; timber, ship (accusative singular) · wudu — wood; timber, ship (nominative singular; subject of byreð)

wēan: wēa — woe, misery (accusative singular, weak masculine)
wēn: wēnan — expect, suppose (1st singular present, with final -e elided before ic: wēn' ic; cf. 'ween')
wīsode: wīsian — guided, showed the way (3rd singular preterite; variant of wīsade; cf. 'wise')
ymb: ymb — after, about, around (preposition; ymb āne niht 'after one night') · ymb — about, concerning (preposition; with accusative of the matter)
ðe: þe — who, which, that (the relative particle, here spelled ðe)
ðonne: þonne — than (after a comparative); also then, when (adverb, conjunction)
ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then · þā — those, the (accusative plural of the demonstrative)
ðū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun, spelled ðū; cf. 'thou')
ðǣm: sē — to that one, to him (dative singular of the demonstrative)
þe: þe — who, which, that (the indeclinable relative particle)
þenceð: þencan — thinks, intends (3rd singular present; cf. 'think')

þām: sē/þæt — them, those; that (dative of the demonstrative)

þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people') · þēoden — lord (vocative singular)
þū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun; cf. 'thou')

āna: āna — alone (adverb; āna wið eallum 'alone against all')

ēode: gān — went (3rd singular preterite, suppletive; cf. 'yode')
ēow: gē — you (dative plural of the 2nd person pronoun; ic ēow wīsige 'I will guide you')

ūs: wē — us, to us (dative plural of wē)
ǣglǣca: ǣglǣca — the awesome one, fearsome assailant (nominative singular; one of the poem's most disputed words — later applied to Beowulf himself, so 'monster' cannot be its whole meaning)
